description: This Java class defines a REST controller for managing customer data in a banking application. It provides endpoints for retrieving all customers, adding a new customer, fetching customer details by customer number, updating customer information, and deleting a customer. The class uses Spring annotations for request mapping and dependency injection, and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: CustomerController
classes.description: A REST controller class that handles HTTP requests related to customer operations such as create, read, update, and delete.

methods.name: getAllCustomers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of all customers.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new customer and create an account.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific customer by customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update existing customer information.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a customer and associated accounts.
